discovery_scope: Canonical default public blog posts under www.tigerdata.com/blog. Ghost CMS URLs were mapped by their exact published slug to the public sitemap route. Author, tag, documentation and product surfaces are excluded.
terminal_evidence: The blog sitemap contained 551 article URLs. The Ghost API advertised 551 posts across six pages, with 51 posts and next null on the last page. Page seven returned zero posts. Both sets agree after canonical public route mapping.
gaps: One short historical post did not pass the automatic 120 word substantive extraction threshold. Its complete returned HTML is retained.
The Ghost response uses a CMS hostname. Transformed import JSON retains each original CMS URL, and original endpoint responses and hashes remain separate.
The web tool rejected a documentation response advertised as text/markdown. Direct public HTML retrieval succeeded, and the article content sections were deliberately read.
